title: Wu-style doll
description: Inspired by "Senro Monogatari: Doll", this Wu-style doll was created by the author in four days.
body:
Preface: "Inspiration Source: 'Kaleidoscope Doll'"
Because the author really loves this work 'Kaleidoscope Doll', but the cartoon version of the dolls in it can only have their own appearance through sponsorship, so the author doesn't want to change others' images. Therefore, the author spent four days creating this mod."
Main Text: You can first experience 'The Spirit World: Dolls' and then this mod. However, the following text contains all the content of this mod.
Currently, there are four dolls in this mod. Right-clicking on each doll will emit the sound "Beep-ee~". Other than that, there are no other functions.
To obtain the dolls, you can put white wool in the Stone cutting machine to make them.
Here is the tutorial for converting the dolls in this mod to your own.
[bilibili](https://space.bilibili.com/3546587974339344/dynamic) Please remember to update the language files in the "lang" folder. If you are in a online, you also need to use the updated "jar" file.
